name: diluted_eps_sequential_antidilution_test
question_template: For the reporting year a company reports net income of {NET_INCOME} USD and declared dividends of {PREF_DIV} USD on non-convertible preferred shares; weighted-average ordinary shares outstanding are {SHARES}. Two potential ordinary share instruments were outstanding all year. (1) Options on {OPTIONS} shares, exercise price {EXERCISE} USD; the average market price for the year was {AVG_PRICE} USD. Under the treasury stock method the options count only if the average price strictly exceeds the exercise price; otherwise they add zero incremental shares. (2) Convertible bonds, face value {BOND_FACE} USD, annual coupon {COUPON} percent paid in cash and expensed in full, convertible into {CONV_SHARES} ordinary shares in total; the tax rate is {TAX} percent and the only earnings effect of assumed conversion is the after-tax interest saving. Test instruments sequentially by incremental per-share effect: options first, then the bonds against the EPS figure that already includes the option shares; include the bonds only if their after-tax interest saving per conversion share is strictly less than that EPS figure. Use exact arithmetic and compute diluted earnings per share in USD per share.

slots.description: Exact basic EPS in USD per share.
Exact treasury-stock incremental shares from options.
After-tax interest saving per conversion share.
Whether the bonds enter diluted EPS.

program:
def solve():
    ni = Fraction(P["NET_INCOME"])
    pd = Fraction(P["PREF_DIV"])
    sh = Fraction(P["SHARES"])
    opt = Fraction(P["OPTIONS"])
    ex = Fraction(P["EXERCISE"])
    avg = Fraction(P["AVG_PRICE"])
    face = Fraction(P["BOND_FACE"])
    coupon = Fraction(P["COUPON"]) / 100
    cs = Fraction(P["CONV_SHARES"])
    tax = Fraction(P["TAX"]) / 100
    earnings = ni - pd
    if earnings <= 0:
        raise ValueError("earnings to ordinary shareholders must be positive")
    basic = earnings / sh
    if avg > ex:
        inc = opt * (avg - ex) / avg
    else:
        inc = Fraction(0)
    eps_after_options = earnings / (sh + inc)
    saving = face * coupon * (1 - tax)
    effect = saving / cs
    if effect < eps_after_options:
        included = "true"
        diluted = (earnings + saving) / (sh + inc + cs)
    else:
        included = "false"
        diluted = eps_after_options
    return {
        "final": diluted,
        "basic_eps_per_share": basic,
        "option_incremental_shares": inc,
        "convertible_per_share_effect": effect,
        "convertible_included": included,
    }
